art_provenance.cover_prompt: Edit Image 1 into a NEW original SQUARE 1:1 cover-art candidate for duohertz track Kitewire Sprint. Image 1 is the content reference: preserve ONLY its memorable concept of TWO separate ribbon-like frequency lines racing diagonally upward like kite strings, crossing once, with a few small sound-buoy marks. Replace its blue sky, clouds, mountains, glossy fantasy rendering and scattered tiny particles completely. Image 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for duohertz's near-black ink, warm-ivory cut paper, bold coral and electric-cyan accent discipline, large halftone print texture and dynamic angular composition; DO NOT copy Image 2's interlocking circular rings, waveform centerpiece or radial layout. Compose a single electric-cyan broad paper ribbon and a single coral broad paper ribbon starting apart at the lower left, crossing ONCE near center, then sprinting toward upper right; place exactly three large warm-ivory diamond buoy marks beside the paths, and a few angled warm-ivory speed slashes behind them. Strong distinct silhouette legible at 100px, restrained print grain, quiet near-black lower fifth for a later local title overlay. All ages, energetic but no strobe. No realistic sky, mountain, water, ring, platform, character, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark or copied game art.
